children: Malaysia's 2027 budget looks neutral to mildly positive for equities, CIMB Securities analyst Ivy Ng Lee Fang says in a note. Tax relief and targeted assistance are expected to support consumer stocks such as 99 Speed Mart, Eco-Shop Marketing, Mr. D.I.Y. Group and QL Resources. Meanwhile, continued infrastructure spending should benefit construction companies like Gamuda and Malayan Cement. Housing incentives and Johor connectivity improvements should benefit UEM Sunrise and Eco World Development, she adds. However, Ng says the 17.6% minimum wage increase to 2,000 ringgit a month from June 2027 could pressure profit margins at labor-intensive businesses, though the impact on overall benchmark earnings is expected to be limited in 2027. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
